arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: hough_type
arg.description: Apecify Hough transform type, 0 for Standard Hough Detection and 1 for Probabilistic Hough Detection

arg.name: threshold
arg.description: Threshould value for hough line detection

arg.name: rho
arg.description: The resolution of the parameter r in pixels.

arg.name: theta
arg.description: The resolution of the parameter theta in radians.

arg.name: minLineLength
arg.description: The minimum number of points that can form a line.

arg.name: maxLineGrap
arg.description: The maximum gap between two points to be considered in the same line.
